text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross got injured during training, so I've hurried her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I'm not doin' too great, but at least it's nothin' the infirmary can't fix up for me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Still, I don't think trainin's in the cards today… It sucks, but I think I should stay put for now.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But while I'm restin' up, everyone else is gonna be out there makin' progress…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …I mean, some athletes tape up their injuries 'n tough it out for races, even when it looks bad.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Compared to that, this is barely a scratch! A li'l runnin' won't hurt, will it?
choice_data_list: I'm not letting you run a single meter.
…Okay. But you have to be careful.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon, why're you bein' so stern all of a sudden? I just wanted to test the waters.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I guess trainin' really is off the table today… All right, I'll stay put and rest to speed up the healin' process…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sounding frustrated, Tamamo Cross drifts back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I just wanna test the waters a bit, yeah? I promise I won't go overboard.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow, owww. Dammit, I think I just made my injury worse.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Owwwww! Urk… I would've been better off stayin' put till it was all better…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After pushing herself too hard, Tamamo Cross worsens her injury. It ends up taking a while for her to fully recover.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I just wanna test the waters a bit, yeah? I promise I won't go overboard.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh! I think I can handle some light joggin'! The school nurse sure knows her stuff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taking care not to worsen her injury, Tamamo Cross manages a light training session.
